## Summary

**Rationalize charts and empty-state panels**

Many empty charts occupy full panel height and say No data.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P2**
- Wave: **V3**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P2-03`
- DUX code: `DUX5-22`

## Scope

DQ, Provider, Pipeline, Trust, Overview.

Screenshot groups: SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-06, SG-07 empty charts

## Concrete change

Keep charts only when a time relationship is decision-relevant; otherwise use compact evidence card. Collapse optional/global charts by default.

## Expected effect

Less visual dead space and clearer absence semantics.

## Acceptance criteria

- First viewport contains only actionable charts; optional empty charts are below fold/collapsed.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Dashboard layout changes.

## Risk

Removing a chart could reduce exploratory value; preserve drill-down.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Chart empty-state rationalization residual after DUX4-21/24.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
